segments.ja329:1.1: Yaṃ annapānassa pure labhāma, taṃ dāni sākhamigameva gacchati;
segments.ja329:1.3: Gacchāma dāni vanameva rādha, asakkatā casma dhanañjayāya [dhanañcayāya (ka.)].
segments.ja329:2.1: Lābho alābho yaso ayaso ca, nindā pasaṃsā ca sukhañca dukkhaṃ;
segments.ja329:2.3: Ete aniccā manujesu dhammā, mā soci kiṃ socasi poṭṭhapāda.
segments.ja329:3.1: Addhā tuvaṃ paṇḍitakosi rādha, jānāsi atthāni anāgatāni;
segments.ja329:3.3: Kathaṃ nu sākhāmigaṃ dakkhisāma [dakkhiyāma (ka.), dakkhāma (syā.)], niddhāvitaṃ [niddhāpitaṃ (sī. syā.), nibbāpitaṃ (pī.), nicchadaṃ (ka.)] rājakulatova jammaṃ.
segments.ja329:4.1: Cāleti kaṇṇaṃ bhakuṭiṃ karoti, muhuṃ muhuṃ bhāyayate [bhāyate (syā.), bhāyāpate (ka.)] kumāre;
segments.ja329:4.3: Sayameva taṃ kāhati kāḷabāhu, yenārakā ṭhassati annapānāti.
